label: Move mouse
description: Move the mouse on the computer's screen without clicking, to hover over something. `args` is `{ x, y, modifiers }`: `x` and `y` in screen pixels, `modifiers` keys held during the move, joined by + (optional).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Where to move, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `move` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.
